name: MacArthur Park
summary: MacArthur Park is a community shopping center in Irving featuring over 12 stores ranging from major clothing retailers to casual dessert shops. Managed by Edens, this well-rated destination serves the Las Colinas area with convenient open-air shopping and dining options.
demographics: MacArthur Park attracts a diverse mix of families and young professionals from the Irving and Las Colinas area, with a median household income ranging from $55,000 to $85,000. The trade area serves a predominantly suburban population with a balanced mix of homeowners and renters, including a significant number of corporate employees from nearby Las Colinas business district. Shoppers typically visit for convenient everyday needs combined with casual dining and entertainment options, with peak traffic during evenings and weekends when families seek accessible retail and restaurant experiences.
description: MacArthur Park is a well-established shopping center located along North MacArthur Boulevard in Irving, Texas, serving the thriving Las Colinas and greater Irving community. This open-air retail destination brings together over a dozen carefully curated retailers spanning major clothing brands, specialty shops, and inviting casual dessert destinations that have made it a neighborhood favorite. Managed by Edens, a respected retail real estate company known for creating vibrant community gathering places, MacArthur Park has earned strong recognition with a 4.3-star rating from thousands of visitors who appreciate its convenient layout and diverse tenant mix. The center's strategic location provides easy access for residents throughout the Las Colinas corridor and surrounding neighborhoods, making it an ideal stop for both planned shopping trips and spontaneous visits. With its blend of national retailers and local favorites, MacArthur Park continues to serve as a reliable community hub where Irving residents can shop, dine, and connect in a welcoming outdoor environment.
